snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat — Enhanced Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat brings the Legends of the Zone Trilogy to a powerful conclusion. Step into the boots of Major Degtyarev, a special service agent sent deep into the Zone to uncover the truth behind a vanished military operation.
Now more atmospheric than ever, Call of Prypiat returns with enhanced lighting, global illumination, and screen space reflections that bring new depth to every location. Navigate the haunting new-explored landscapes, survive new deadly hazards and witness yet unseen wonders — now upscaled and enhanced. Available on May 20, 2025, for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Full FAQ:  https://www.stalker-game.com/en/faq
